rows.title: Review: 'The Voice of Hind Rajab' re-creates a rescue mission with the real pleas of a terrified girl
rows.comment: The movie is a powerfully blunt instrument of empathy
rows.verdict_le10: The movie is a powerfully blunt instrument of empathy
rows.dek_lead: The movie is a powerfully blunt instrument of empathy. Ben Hania’s insistence on close-up melodramatics — faces in anguish, a handheld camera glued to them — sometimes overshadows a thirst for something more analytical.
